review_findings.title: Default Tauri tool cache crosses the App Server sandbox boundary
review_findings.details: The canonical build reaches NSIS and reports Acesso negado while recreating the tool cache under AppData\Local\tauri\NSIS. The executor sandbox has ReadAndExecute there, while the project target directory has Modify. Tauri 2.5 supports bundle.useLocalToolsDir to use target/.tauri.
